typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsRateIndex_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		RATE_INDEX as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsodbaswaplegandproductswap
fromcalypsodbaswaplegandproductswap derive({Copy of RATE_INDEX} = RATE_INDEX) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		RATE_INDEX as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		RATE_INDEX = {Copy of RATE_INDEX}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsRateIndex_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsRateIndex
